info.name: Fyno Rest Fire an Event Fyno Verify API

params.name: WSID
params.description: Enter your workspace ID. You can obtain this value from the API Keys page within your Fyno account.

params.name: version
params.description: Specify the version for which you would like to manage the user profile.

params.name: request_id
params.description:
Specify the request id of the triggered notification event that sent the OTP to the user.
You must use this query parameter if **you've disabled "Use destination as id"** in the Fyno Verify setting.

params.name: destination
params.description:
Enter the destination where the OTP is sent. It can be either mobile no or email id.
You must use this query parameter if **you've enabled "Use destination as id"** in the Fyno Verify setting.

params.name: otp
params.description: Enter the OTP which you want to validate.

items.docs: This API enables you to validate the OTP entered by the user using either `request_id` (received in response of the Fire an Event API) or `destination` (such as phone number, email).
